# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Charts — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 19 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Layout — 9 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #0b1626);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #0b1626 | Slide and document background; cards that sit on the warm canvas. Default ground for all text tokens. |
| `--canvas` | #f8f7f4 | #0b1626 | Warm off-white page background for websites and landing pages. Documents and slides stay on surface. |
| `--surface-raised` | #f2ede7 | #122136 | Warm grey panels, cards and bands sitting on surface or canvas; alternate table rows. |
| `--surface-sunk` | #ebe4dc | #1a2c45 | Recessed areas: code blocks, input fills, the cover-page client box. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #ecf2f9);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0f2136;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #0f2136 | #ecf2f9 | Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk. |
| `--ink-muted` | #4b5b6e | #a6b5c8 | Secondary text, captions, footers and metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk. |

## Color · Charts

### Use

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |

| `--chart-1` | #c24c12 | #f47a3a | Chart series 1 (the series that matters most). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #e6ddd3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #2a3f5b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e6ddd3;
```

### Tokens (19)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #e6ddd3 | #2a3f5b | Hairlines, table borders and dividers. Decorative only; never the only thing marking a control. |
| `--navy` | #0f2136 | #1a2c45 | Deep brand ground: dark title slides, footer bands, the cover block. Pair with on-navy text. |
| `--blue` | #145aa8 | #6ea5ec | Incaendo Blue (#145AA8, measured from the logo). Supporting colour only (under 5%): focus ring, info messages, chart series 3. As text, on surface, canvas, surface-raised or blue-soft. |
| `--blue-soft` | #e5eef8 | #15304f | Tinted background behind blue text: info callouts and info badges only. |
| `--action` | #c24c12 | #f47a3a | Action orange: primary buttons and the main call to action. White label in light theme (4.84:1), navy label in dark theme. Never use the logo orange for buttons. |
| `--action-hover` | #a83f0a | #ff9a62 | Hover state of action fills. |
| `--action-pressed` | #8f3608 | #ffb68a | Pressed (active) state of action fills. White label 7.78:1 in light theme. |
| `--overlay` | rgba(15,33,54,0.6) | rgba(0,0,0,0.7) | Scrim behind modals, the mobile menu and image lightboxes. |
| `--orange` | #ee5d10 | #f47a3a | Logo orange (#EE5D10, measured from the logo). Accents only: section bars, the i-dot, the + on stats, large display text 24px+. 3.4:1 on white, so never for body text or with a white label; use orange-text or action. |
| `--orange-text` | #b5450b | #ff9a62 | Readable orange for text: eyebrows, links, highlighted words in headlines, icons. On surface, canvas, surface-raised or orange-soft. |
| `--orange-soft` | #fdede3 | #3b1f10 | Brand tint: icon circles, highlighted cards, callouts, table header rows, brand badges. Pair with orange-text or ink. |
| `--success` | #1d7446 | #5fcf93 | Done, approved, on track. Always with a word, never colour alone. |
| `--success-soft` | #e3f3ea | #123324 | Background behind success text. |
| `--warning` | #8f5b00 | #f0b44c | At risk, pending, needs attention. Always with a word. |
| `--warning-soft` | #fbf0d9 | #3a2a0b | Background behind warning text. |
| `--danger` | #b3261e | #ff8a80 | Blocked, failed, overdue. Always with a word. |
| `--danger-soft` | #fbe7e5 | #3d1513 | Background behind danger text. |
| `--focus` | #145aa8 | #6ea5ec | Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Stays blue so it stands out from orange buttons. At least 5.5:1 on every surface in both themes. |
| `--link` | #b5450b | #ff9a62 | Links. An alias of orange-text, so links follow the readable brand orange in every theme. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 64px/72px "Plus Jakarta Sans", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-web-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `web-display` | `.web-display`, `--text-web-display` | 64px / 72px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Website and landing page hero headline, one per page. 36px/44px on phones. |
| `web-h1` | `.web-h1`, `--text-web-h1` | 48px / 56px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 800 | `display` | Inner page titles on the web. 32px/40px on phones. |
| `web-h2` | `.web-h2`, `--text-web-h2` | 40px / 48px | 700 | `display` | Website section titles. 28px/36px on phones. |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 48px / 56px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 800 | `display` | Cover titles and title slides. One per page. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 36px / 44px | 700 | `display` | Page and slide titles. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 28px / 36px | 700 | `display` | Document sections; slide headlines. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 20px / 28px | 700 | `display` | Subsections, card titles. |
| `eyebrow` | `.eyebrow`, `--text-eyebrow` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 700 | `display` | Kicker above a title, uppercase, in orange-text. |
| `web-lead` | `.web-lead`, `--text-web-lead` | 20px / 30px | 400 | `sans` | Hero and section lead paragraphs on the web. 18px/28px on phones. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Lead paragraphs, slide body copy. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Default text for pages and documents (11pt in Word or Google Docs). |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Emphasis inside body copy and table headers. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Table cells, notes, card descriptions. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Footers, figure captions, legal lines; ink-muted. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Endpoints, commands and code in technical proposals. |

| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Plus Jakarta Sans", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight stacks; badge padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between related lines; table cell padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding (compact); paragraph gap. |
| `--space-5` | 24px | Card padding; grid gutter. |
| `--space-6` | 32px | Between blocks within a section. |
| `--space-7` | 48px | Between sections; slide margin. |
| `--space-8` | 64px | Page margins on covers and title slides; section padding on phones. |
| `--space-9` | 96px | Vertical padding of website sections on desktop. |
| `--space-10` | 128px | Hero padding and the largest section breaks on desktop. |


### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |

| `--shadow-1` | 0 1px 2px rgba(15,33,54,0.08), 0 2px 8px rgba(15,33,54,0.06) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) | Raised cards on a surface or the warm canvas. Prefer surface-raised over shadow where possible. |
| `--shadow-2` | 0 4px 12px rgba(15,33,54,0.10), 0 2px 4px rgba(15,33,54,0.06) · dark: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Floating elements: dropdowns, sticky header once scrolled, hovered cards. |

## Layout

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--bp-sm: 640px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--bp-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--bp-sm` | 640px | Breakpoint: large phones. Below this, one column and full-width buttons. |
| `--bp-md` | 768px | Breakpoint: tablets. Two-column grids start here. |
| `--bp-lg` | 1024px | Breakpoint: laptops. Full navigation replaces the mobile menu; three-column grids. |
| `--bp-xl` | 1280px | Breakpoint: desktops. Four-column grids and the widest hero layouts. |
| `--container-text` | 720px | Maximum width for reading text: articles, section intros, forms. |
| `--container-content` | 1200px | Maximum width of page content on websites and landing pages. |
| `--gutter` | 24px | Grid gutter and page side padding from bp-md up. |
| `--gutter-mobile` | 16px | Grid gutter and page side padding on phones. |
| `--tap-min` | 44px | Minimum height and width of anything tappable, including padding around text links. |
